name: week
title: This week in investor relations
subtitle: What needs chasing, the meetings booked and the register. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Rule findings, overdue follow-ups, holders gone quiet, sellers, meetings, deadlines and blackouts.
sections.sql: select kind,record,due,detail from v_attention order by due nulls last,kind,record

sections.title: Meetings booked
sections.sql: select code,held_on as day,starts,kind,institution_name as investor,team,contacts,coalesce(blackout,'') as blackout from v_meetings where status='booked' and held_on>=current_date order by held_on,starts

sections.title: Follow-ups open
sections.sql: select code,due_on,institution,owner,action from v_follow_ups where done_on is null order by due_on

name: register
title: The register
subtitle: Who owns the company on the latest register, who moved, and who nobody has seen.

sections.title: Holders
sections.sql: select rank,name,kind,style,shares,round(pct_bps/100.0,2) as pct,change,last_met,days_since_met from v_holders where shares>0 order by rank

sections.title: Who moved since the last register
sections.sql: select name,move,prev_shares as shares_before,shares as shares_now,last_met,met_in_90d_before as meetings_in_90_days_before from v_movers order by change

sections.title: Holders gone quiet
sections.sql: select name,round(pct_bps/100.0,2) as pct,owner,last_met,days_since_met from v_quiet order by pct_bps desc

sections.title: Targets
sections.sql: select name,style,city,tier,meetings_12m,last_met,note from v_targets order by tier,meetings_12m desc

name: disclosure
title: Disclosure and calendar
subtitle: Every rule in docs/compliance.md checked against the records, and the dates that matter.

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule,record,issue from v_compliance order by rule,record

sections.title: Calendar
sections.sql: select code,title,period_end,on_date,due_by,lodged_on,blackout from v_calendar order by on_date

sections.title: Blackouts
sections.sql: select event,title,starts_on,ends_on from v_blackouts order by starts_on
